gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest leans on open-mouthed curves up top. Noto Sans Khmer follows in a plain sans with small letters that stand almost capital-tall, so give it a little extra size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Bookish charm comes from Mystery Quest, whose curves gape open and whose ascenders stay tucked in close. Noto Sans Khojki then carries the text with wide exits and a generous eye on every e, easy going over many lines.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kr: Chunky, storybook display letters meet a sturdy text face here, with Mystery Quest gaping open on every curve above Noto Sans KR. Its big x-height and stubby ascenders are the pair's real strength.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands on an x-height pushed well past the usual, with mouths left open on c, e and a. Mystery Quest does the bookish, nostalgic showing off in its display curves, and the body font simply gets on with the reading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Open jaws on every curved stroke are the giveaway of Mystery Quest, a display face with a nostalgic, bookish streak. Noto Sans Lao Looped then lays down words as solid blocks, bowls left unfinished on one side, in a modern plain sans.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Mystery Quest opens with a nostalgic, bookish air. Noto Sans Lepcha brings a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals and curves that stay wide, which is the strongest thing about this sans-serif pairing.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads approachable and contemporary, its tall-bodied small letters curving open as if gaping. Mystery Quest sits above it with compact ascenders and a bookish, nostalgic display voice, and the two make an easy sans-serif partnership.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Mystery Quest brings open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, a bookish, nostalgic display face. Noto Sans Lisu follows with a plain sans of wide-open s curves and tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Compact ascenders over tall lowercase mark Mystery Quest, a display face with open jaws on its curves. And Noto Sans Lydian, its sans-serif partner, keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, with openings as wide as a sprung paper clip.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Storybook display, modern text: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve, bookish and nostalgic. And Noto Sans Mahajani sets a sans-serif lowercase that stands tall against its capitals, with a funnel-wide throat in the e.
